Additionally, the company provides advanced cloud capabilities for customers with high demands for artificial intelligence.

product.name: SEALMINER
product.description: A line of application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC) Bitcoin mining machines designed for high hash rate and energy-efficient cryptocurrency mining.

product.name: Cloud Mining
product.description: A hosted Bitcoin mining service that lets customers purchase hash-rate plans and mine without owning or operating physical mining hardware.

product.name: Bitdeer AI Cloud
product.description: A cloud computing platform providing NVIDIA GPU instances and clustered infrastructure for artificial intelligence, machine learning, and high-performance computing workloads.

product.name: Minerbase
product.description: A modular mining-container product that houses cryptocurrency mining machines with integrated cooling and infrastructure for mobile or deployed mining operations.

product.name: Data Center Services
product.description: Design, construction, operation, and maintenance services for large-scale cryptocurrency mining and high-performance computing data centers.

product.name: ReMine
product.description: A marketplace for buying and selling Bitdeer orders and mining-related rights, including transferable SEALMINER reservation rights.
